title: Bill 104 kitchenettes for rebuilding homes
summary: The option for kitchenettes in additional dwelling units has been removed from Bill 104, which had let owners add two kitchenettes to a main home for extra living space. The fire department said more kitchens on one lot can mean more people, vehicles and density. If the bill passes, the department will recommend fire protection measures that owners must install.

timeline.text: If the bill passes, the fire department will recommend fire protection measures that owners must install.
